description: Defines parameters, enums, structs, and classes related to PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel) configuration in 5G NR, derived from 3GPP TS 38.331 specifications.

classes.name: pucch_common_all_formats
classes.description: Contains common configuration parameters for PUCCH formats, including hopping, DMRS, code rate, slots, BPSK, and HARQ acknowledgment.

classes.name: pucch_format_0_cfg
classes.description: Configuration parameters for PUCCH format 0, including initial cyclic shift.

classes.name: pucch_format_1_cfg
classes.description: Configuration parameters for PUCCH format 1, including initial cyclic shift and time domain occupancy.

classes.name: pucch_format_2_3_cfg
classes.description: Configuration for PUCCH formats 2 and 3, including number of PRBs.

classes.name: pucch_format_4_cfg
classes.description: Configuration for PUCCH format 4, including occupancy length and index.

classes.name: pucch_resource
classes.description: Defines a PUCCH resource with ID, starting PRB, second hop, symbols, starting symbol index, format, and format-specific parameters.

classes.name: pucch_resource_set
classes.description: Defines a set of PUCCH resources, including resource set ID, list of resource IDs, and optional max payload size.

classes.name: pucch_power_control
classes.description: Contains power control parameters for PUCCH, including P0 settings, path-loss reference signals, delta power adjustments, and adjustment flags.

classes.name: pucch_config
classes.description: Main configuration structure for PUCCH, including resource sets, resource list, common format parameters, SR list, ACK/NACK data, payload sizes, and power control.

methods.name: to_max_code_rate_float
methods.description: Converts max_pucch_code_rate enum to its float representation.
